value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round 1: verified all 17 unresolved threads at 3df1e75. Plan bounded in-process verification, raw-field privacy, semantic timestamps, recoverable consolidation, current atomic exports, attribution and regression proofs. No private source data is required.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented all 17 thread fixes and both orchestrator findings. Verification streams indexed regular files with 64 MiB run and 8 MiB file caps, 100000 entries per root, conservative refusals, no rg dependency. Content age uses memory_changed_at with created_at fallback. Merge receipts survive failures; exports stage then rename and regenerate stale indexes. SDK gap: the injected host client asserts pm-extension without an author flag; a native dispatcher adapter clears that fallback and preserves the documented author chain. Focused attribution, 100k URL and bounded streaming regressions pass.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof ledger: 22 targeted regressions fail with the corresponding behavior reverted and pass after restoration. Cases cover URL complexity, the fresh README invocation, matching subjects, surviving merge targets, durable merge receipts, raw-field privacy, canceled slug reuse, semantic age, canceled imports, current export paths/indexes, atomic refusal/failure cleanup, excluded exported evidence, safe gh arguments, reverse collisions, prepare environment precedence, portable null devices, archive/artifact assertions, independent inventory/text search without rg, SDK author precedence, root-remedy text, and formatting-only import timestamps. The 100k adversarial scan runs in a child process; a two-second scan deadline kills the reverted regex, while the fixed scan stays below 500 ms. Synthetic OS hooks prove devNull portability. Restored regression baselines pass; the linked pm runner passed 19 of 19. Full npm execution passed 106 of 106 tests; the first strict coverage attempt exposed two missing export destination branches, now covered by empty-target publication and nonempty-target refusal scenarios. No thresholds changed.
